divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: a folder count, then a store-wide text scan for the entity name (first timing out, then run in parallel shards) that hits exactly three matters; repeated coverage checks (rescans, saved-output reconciliation, file-type census) confirm the three; reads of pleadings, engagement letters, settlement and closing papers establish the firm's adverse role in each; the answer names the three with roles and status caveats. Reviews kept asking for coverage proof and status checks, which the agents met with extra scan and check stages; one agent-defined stage (a file-type coverage check) mapped to a file-name search.
